title: Legal Notice No. 4 of 2026 — THE EMERGENCY POWERS REGULATIONS, 2025
text:
Legal Supplement Part B—Vol. 65, No. 5—13th January, 2026 7
LEGAL NOTICE NO. 4
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO
THE EMERGENCY POWERS REGULATIONS, 2025
REVOCATION ORDER
MADE BY THE MINISTER OF HOMELAND SECURITY IN ACCORDANCE
WITH PARAGRAPH 9 OF THE SCHEDULE TO THE EMERGENCY POWERS
REGULATIONS, 2025
WHEREAS it is enacted by regulation 14 of the Emergency Powers
Regulations, 2025, that the provisions of the Schedule shall have effect
for the purpose of the preventive detention of persons:
And whereas on the 19th day of November, 2025, a detention order
was made to detain DANNY GUERRA of 3½ Milemark, North
Oropouche Road, Sangre Grande, at the Eastern Correctional
Rehabilitation Centre, Santa Rosa, Arima, or such other place as the
Minister may from time to time direct, pursuant to the Schedule to the
Emergency Powers Regulations, 2025:
And whereas it is provided at paragraph 9 of the Emergency
Powers Regulations, 2025, that the Minister may revoke a detention
order at any time:
Now, therefore, I, the Honourable Roger Alexander, Minister of
Homeland Security, in exercise of the powers conferred on me, do hereby
revoke the detention order dated the 19th day of November, 2025, made
in relation to the said DANNY GUERRA of 3½ Milemark, North
Oropouche Road, Sangre Grande.
Made this 2nd day of January, 2026.
R. ALEXANDER
Minister of Homeland Security
PRINTED AND PUBLISHED BY THE GOVERNMENT PRINTER, PORT-OF-SPAIN
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO—2026
